summary: TOOL-4 Filter products by category and brand
description:
As a customer, I want to filter so I can narrow down the catalogue.

* Selecting one category → only products from that category appear.
* Selecting two categories → products from both appear.
* Combining a category and a brand → only products matching both appear.
* Unchecking all filters → the full list returns.

criteria.text: Selecting one category shows only products from that category.
Selecting two categories shows products from both categories.
Combining a category filter and a brand filter shows only products matching both.
Unchecking all filters returns the full product list.

cases.title: Filtering by a single category shows only that category's products
cases.preconditions: The product catalogue page is open with no filters selected. The catalogue contains products in at least two different categories (e.g. Category A and Category B), and the tester knows which products belong to Category A.
steps: Note the products currently shown in the unfiltered list and which category each belongs to.
cases.expected: Only products belonging to Category A appear in the list. No product from any other category is shown.

cases.title: Filtering by two categories shows products from both
cases.preconditions: The product catalogue page is open with no filters selected. The catalogue contains at least one product in Category A and at least one product in Category B, plus at least one product in a third category C.
steps: Also select the category filter 'Category B' so both are selected at the same time.
cases.expected: Products from Category A and products from Category B both appear in the list. Products belonging only to Category C are not shown.

cases.title: Combining a category and a brand shows only products matching both
cases.preconditions: The product catalogue page is open with no filters selected. The catalogue contains at least one product in Category A of Brand X, at least one product in Category A of a different brand, and at least one product of Brand X in a different category.
cases.expected: Only products that are both in Category A and of Brand X appear. Category A products of other brands and Brand X products of other categories are not shown.

cases.title: Unchecking all filters restores the full product list
cases.preconditions: The product catalogue page is open with no filters selected. The catalogue contains products in several categories and brands.
steps: Record the complete unfiltered product list.
Select the category filter 'Category A' and the brand filter 'Brand X' and confirm the list is filtered.
Uncheck the brand filter 'Brand X' so that no filter is selected.
cases.expected: The full product list is shown again, matching the list recorded in step 1.

cases.title: Unchecking one of two selected categories leaves the other category's filter applied
cases.preconditions: The product catalogue page is open with no filters selected. The catalogue contains at least one product in Category A and at least one product in Category B.
steps: Select the category filters 'Category A' and 'Category B'.
Confirm products from both categories are shown.
Uncheck 'Category B' only, leaving 'Category A' selected.
cases.expected: Only products from Category A appear; the full list does not return because one filter is still selected.

cases.title: Category and brand combination with no matching products
cases.preconditions: The product catalogue page is open with no filters selected. The catalogue contains a Category A and a Brand Y, but no product that is both in Category A and of Brand Y.
cases.expected: No products are listed, since no product matches both the category and the brand. The exact empty-result message or display is not specified in the story.
